title: China-to-Albania Solar PV Inverter Compliance Gap Matrix
provenance: AI-compiled, multi-model cross-checked, not human-verified. Informational only; confirm with the official regulator and a qualified professional. Not legal/certification/customs/market-access advice.

rows.requirement: EMC Evidence for PV Inverter Export to Albania
rows.target_requirement: Albania-facing PV inverter EMC evidence should be prepared around IEC 61000 test methods and IEC 62920. ERE and OST may require EMC evidence as part of grid-connection or net-metering documentation. Project documents can also add local utility expectations for harmonic limits, voltage ride-through, and site interface conditions.
target_standards: IEC 62920 — Photovoltaic power generating systems — EMC requirements and test methods for power conversion equipment
IEC 61000 series — electromagnetic compatibility test methods and limits
ERE / OST project documentation requirements where connection is requested
rows.china_equivalent: China PV inverter EMC evidence commonly relies on GB/T 37408-2021, NB/T 32004, and CNAS-accredited laboratory reports under China domestic requirements. These reports support technical comparison, but they are not substitutes for IEC 62920 and project-specified IEC 61000 evidence.
china_standards: China test reports and domestic acceptance records
rows.gap: Map Chinese EMC evidence clause-by-clause to IEC 62920 and relevant IEC 61000 tests before Albania submission. Exporters should prepare model-specific reports from internationally accepted labs, confirm any differences in test conditions, and align documentation to the Albania site configuration before energisation.

mandatory_status.target: Mandatory where required by ERE/OST project review, net-metering, or local utility acceptance; evidence scope is model and site specific
mandatory_status.cn: Chinese GB/T/NB/T EMC evidence may support domestic review but is not a direct Albania market substitute

rows.verdict: [INFORMATIONAL] Do not rely on Chinese GB/T 37408-2021 or NB/T 32004 EMC evidence alone for Albania. Prepare IEC 62920 and IEC 61000 reports for the exact inverter model, then confirm acceptance with ERE, OST, and the project owner.

source.publisher: International Electrotechnical Commission (IEC) and Albanian utility-referenced utility expectations

rows.requirement: Grid-Connection and Project Acceptance for Solar PV Inverters in Albania
rows.target_requirement: Albania-facing PV inverters are reviewed in ERE / OST project packages at the connection point. The grid route, metering model, protection coordination, remote controls, reactive-power and voltage support settings, and commissioning conditions are project-specific and can differ from Chinese domestic acceptance practice.
target_standards: ERE technical and operational rules for generator and storage-grid interfaces used for project-specific interconnection
OST interconnection practice at connection points and supply substations
IEC 61000 and related grid-interface test methods for inverter behavior under site conditions
rows.china_equivalent: China commonly applies GB/T 37408 and GB/T 19964 in domestic grid studies and acceptance for photovoltaic systems, plus utility-specific operational practices. These are useful for technical comparison but do not automatically satisfy Albanian project interconnection documentation.
rows.gap: For Albania-bound inverters, prepare project-level single-line diagrams, fault and trip settings, islanding and reconnection parameters, remote monitoring and dispatch compatibility, protection coordination, and commissioning records tied to the selected ERE / OST route.

mandatory_status.target: Mandatory where interconnection, dispatch participation, or market activity is requested by the project structure
mandatory_status.cn: Chinese grid-connection templates are useful but do not replace Albania project interconnection gates

rows.verdict: [INFORMATIONAL] Grid acceptance is the key Albania gate for PV inverters. Build per-site evidence for protection, voltage/frequency, metering, and commissioning rather than relying on China acceptance reports.

rows.requirement: Solar PV Inverter Safety Baseline under TS EN 62109
rows.target_requirement: For Albania-facing PV inverters, TS EN 62109-1 and TS EN 62109-2 evidence is commonly used as the practical electrical safety baseline for power conversion and grid-feeding performance. Whether it is mandatory depends on the exact model scope, project route, and the tender or utility acceptance terms used in Albania.
rows.china_equivalent: China documentation often includes GB/T 37408 and grid acceptance records for PV inverters. These can support technical comparison, but EN/IEC 62109 evidence and project-specific safety interpretation remain necessary for Albania-facing filing.
rows.gap: Exporters should prepare inverter-model IEC/EN safety evidence at the same granularity as Albania-facing grid contracts, including thermal tests, isolation and creepage distances, overcurrent and overvoltage protections, fault response behavior, and operation manuals in English plus Albania-facing labels.

mandatory_status.target: Mandatory where Albania-facing inverters are scoped into the project safety acceptance route and where project documents require TS EN or EN-series safety evidence
mandatory_status.cn: China EN/GB evidence is supportive but not a direct replacement for Albania project acceptance

rows.verdict: [INFORMATIONAL] Do not treat China inverter safety evidence as a ready Albania submission. Map test scope and parameter assumptions to TS EN 62109 and the Albania project acceptance package.
